caseNameFull: Nudelman, Director of Finance of Illinois v. Globe Varnish Co.
attorneys: Messrs. John E. Cassidy, Attorney General of Illinois, Montgomery S. Winning, Edwin T. Breen, Eli J. Bibo, and Philip J. Simon, Assistant Attorneys General, for petitioner. Messrs. Thurlow G. Essington, Russell Whitman, William P. Sidley, and Hamilton K. Beebe for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied for the want of jurisdiction. Davis v. Preston, 280 U. S. 406.
